articles.title: OKX and NYSE partner to bridge tradfi and crypto markets in joint venture led by Andrew Cuomo
articles.snippet: The goal is to enable OKX’s 120 million global users to access ICE futures and NYSE tokenized equities markets, the two U.S. companies announced.

articles.title: Bitcoin price may hit $24K if US stock market crashes by 50%, analyst warns
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s drop to $23,980 remains the worst-case scenario as weaker ETF flows and low US demand show big investors are still cautious.

articles.title: GPT-5.6 Rumors Heat Up as Users Swear ChatGPT Suddenly Got Smarter
articles.snippet: Many AI users are convinced that OpenAI is quietly running GPT-5.6 inside ChatGPT. OpenAI isn't confirming anything.

articles.title: Amazon Won't Release Sam Altman Film 'Artificial' Following $50 Billion OpenAI Investment
articles.snippet: Amazon is pulling out of "Artificial," a film about Sam Altman's brief ouster from OpenAI, not long after investing $50 billion in the firm.
